description: Better Horses is a Minecraft mod focused on making horses a genuinely viable and rewarding way to travel, fight, and explore. From calling your horse from anywhere to improving traversal through forests, water, and rough terrain, Better Horses aims to turn horses from an early-game novelty into long-term companions worth investing in.

mods.name: Icy's Better Horses
mods.description: Turns horses from an early-game novelty into long-term companions: ownership and bonding, fifteen breeds with their own coats and biomes, dedicated tack, carts, and a stack of riding improvements.
